title: ISM Services PMI (Jan 2027 data)
source: EST: ISM publishes the Services PMI at 10:00 ET on the third business day of the month — the derivation this calendar's four existing services entries already carry (ism-services-2026-09-03, -2026-10-05, -2026-11-04, -2026-12-03), and the one this session corroborated against an ISM primary for the first time: the 2026 annual seasonal-factor announcement (PRNewswire, 2026-01-29) states the changes were effective with 'the January 2026 ISM Services PMI, which was released on February 4, 2026', and 2026-02-04 is February 2026's third business day (Mon 02-02, Tue 02-03, Wed 02-04). February 2027's first three business days are Mon 2027-02-01, Tue 2027-02-02 and Wed 2027-02-03: 2027-01-01 is a Friday holiday, the next federal holiday is Washington's Birthday 2027-02-15, and the NYSE trades normal sessions across the window. ismworld.org was re-probed direct 2026-09-05 and returned a 922-byte Google-reCAPTCHA challenge on its ROB-calendar path and HTTP 400 on its Report-On-Business path, so no 2027 schedule could be read and this is a rule-derived date and nothing more, checked 2026-09-05
notes: DISCOVERED during the ism-manufacturing-2027-02-01 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). Fills the same year-boundary coverage gap as its manufacturing sibling: this calendar tracked ISM services monthly through 2026-12-03 and then stopped at the 2026 boundary rather than at any analytical judgement. Filed at impact high to match the four existing services entries. READ IT, DO NOT TRADE IT — the ism-services-2026-11-04 initial research measured all 8 of 2026's services releases and found release-day moves in TLT/^TNX/SPY/QQQ/XLF/IWM statistically nil, and ism-services-2026-12-03's research added that the 10:00 ET release hour is quieter than an ordinary hour in four of five instruments. Two facts specific to this edition, both from the manufacturing sibling's ledger: it is the ANNUAL SEASONAL-REVISION edition on the services side too (the same ISM announcement revises 'the Manufacturing and Services indexes' together, so the prior months this print is judged against restate on the same morning), and it sits inside the calendar's most Fed-contaminated corridor — 5 trading sessions after fomc-2027-01-27, in a window where all 12 February manufacturing releases 2015-2026 landed within 4 sessions of an FOMC decision. Attribution of any move in this corridor to ISM rather than the Fed is unavailable in either direction.
